Voice intake UI
Launch a local desktop UI.
User speaks their vision; audio is transcribed live into an editable text area.
User can stop, edit, and submit the response.
API key onboarding
UI includes a “Get API Key” path that explains how to obtain an OpenAI key.
The key is stored locally and used by all AI calls.
The UI indicates whether the key is present (red/green state).
Conversational requirements capture
The system asks a sequence of clarifying questions based on missing information.
Each user response is appended to a conversation log stored locally.
The AI generates the next question until enough information is collected.
Pipeline transforms (intent → structure)
The captured intent is transformed into structured artifacts in stages:
Vision → Requirements → Stakeholders/Phases → Epics → Stories → Tasks
Tasks are scored for complexity/effort.
Outputs are compiled into proposal artifacts.
Outputs and artifacts
JSON artifacts are written locally to storage/.
Additional outputs include proposal drafts, and optional exports to PDF/Excel.
Optional local UIs exist for reviewing or editing intermediate artifacts.
In functional terms, this is a self‑contained offline workflow: start from voice or text input, guide the user with AI‑driven prompts, and end with structured plans and proposal outputs. Use this as a blueprint: replicate the UI intake, the AI question loop, the local artifact storage, and the multi‑step pipeline that converts unstructured intent into structured execution plans.
